findings.title: Crawler received bot-challenge pages instead of content
findings.observation: 1 URLs returned a challenge/interstitial (e.g. 'Client Challenge', 'Just a moment') to the Zunitech crawler. These pages were excluded from content scoring.
findings.recommendation: Check CDN/WAF bot settings (Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai). If AI search crawlers get the same challenge, they cannot read or cite these pages. Allow verified search/AI crawlers, then re-audit. (Our crawler is not an AI crawler; this shows risk, not proof.)
findings.what_it_means: Some pages showed a 'checking your browser' or similar challenge to our crawler instead of the content.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.observation: 3 internal links point to 1 URLs that return an error (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/cakes → HTTP 403).
findings.recommendation: Fix or remove these links, or redirect the old URLs (301) to the right page. Broken links waste crawl budget and send users and bots to dead ends.
findings.what_it_means: Some links on your site lead to pages that do not exist.

findings.title: Sitemap lists URLs that should not be there
findings.observation: 1 crawled sitemap URLs are errors, redirects, noindex or canonicalised elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: List only final, indexable URLs that return 200. Mixed signals waste crawl budget and make engines trust the sitemap less.
findings.what_it_means: The sitemap lists pages that are broken, forward elsewhere or are hidden from search.

findings.title: Very short pages
findings.observation: 3 pages have fewer than 150 words of main content (read as raw HTML; content added by JavaScript is not counted: re-crawl with --render to compare).
findings.recommendation: Expand pages that should rank or be cited, or consolidate them.
findings.what_it_means: Some pages have very little text.

findings.title: No About or Contact page linked from the crawled pages
findings.recommendation: Publish About (who you are, since when, where) and Contact (address, phone) pages; they anchor the brand entity for engines and people.
findings.what_it_means: We could not find an About or Contact page.

findings.title: llms.txt not found
findings.recommendation: Optional. llms.txt is a proposed convention; major AI engines have not confirmed using it. Low effort, low priority; never a substitute for crawlable content.
findings.what_it_means: The site has no llms.txt file, a proposed file for AI tools.
